Main charitable entity types: Associação sem fins lucrativos and fundação under Lei n.º 25/VI/2003 de 21 de julho (with Código Civil arts. 157 ff., e.g. art. 185 for foundations), constituted/registered at the Conservatória dos Registos (Registo de Pessoas Coletivas, DGRNI, Ministério da Justiça) and published in the Boletim Oficial II Série (art. 9.1.b); optional OSCD status (organização da sociedade civil de desenvolvimento, Lei n.º 114/VIII/2016); foreign associations/foundations need a Ministry of Justice despacho de autorização before their local representation is registered; optional utilidade pública status (Decreto-Lei 59/2005 as amended by Lei 16/X/2022).
Key local requirements: Registered seat (sede) in Cabo Verde; Portuguese-language estatutos and constitutive act (escritura or registo de constituição at the Conservatória); governing bodies (Assembleia Geral, Direção/Conselho Diretivo, Conselho Fiscal) - statutory founder minimum not confirmed in published sources; no nationality bar found (Constitution art. 51: association free without administrative authorisation); NIF tax number for the entity and for foreign directors; foreign founders can act via apostilled power of attorney to a local lawyer; branch of a foreign NGO requires Ministry of Justice authorisation plus a named local legal representative.
Est. cost & time: Registry/notary emolumentos (Decreto-Lei 70/2009 tariff) and Boletim Oficial publication fee: unpublished amounts, typically modest; local lawyer/representative + translations/apostille realistically CVE 100,000-250,000 (~USD 1,050-2,600, estimate); 1-3 months for a local association, 2-6 months for a foreign NGO representation (ministerial despacho first).
Notes: Lei n.º 25/VI/2003 (21 July 2003) remains in force: 2025-2026 Boletim Oficial extracts still cite art. 9.1.b for association and foundation constitutions | Foreign entities: 2026 BO extracts show a US (Delaware) non-profit and a foreign foundation registered as permanent representations only after a despacho de autorização do exercício de atividades em Cabo Verde (Ministry of Justice), criteria unpublished | Lei 114/VIII/2016 (OSCD statute) excludes religious, political, union and military bodies | Utilidade pública: Decreto-Lei 59/2005 (19 Sept), amended by Lei 16/X/2022 (30 Dec) + Despacho 41/2022; grants fiscal/fee benefits, annual report & accounts to the Government | Casa do Cidadão handles 'empresa no dia' company formation, not associations | Portuguese only; CIVICUS reports registration refusals rare | CVE pegged to EUR (110.265 CVE/EUR), ~95 CVE/USD
Main bottleneck (remote foreign founder): In-person Conservatória/notary formalities in Portuguese require a local lawyer under apostilled power of attorney (and, for a foreign-NGO branch, a prior Ministry of Justice authorisation with unpublished criteria), plus obtaining a NIF and opening a local bank account.
Registration fee (USD): unpublished (Conservatória emolumentos under Decreto-Lei 70/2009 plus Boletim Oficial publication fee; amounts not published online)
Charitable deduction regime: Código dos Benefícios Fiscais (Lei 26/VIII/2013, amended Lei 102/VIII/2016) mecenato: companies deduct 130% of gifts up to 10/1000 of turnover (art. 31); individuals in organised accounting 130% as expense, others a tax credit of 30% of gifts capped at 15% of the IRPS liability (art. 32); only to beneficiaries in arts. 33/36-40 (e.g. IPSS and utilidade pública bodies for social mecenato), with project recognition by the line ministry (art. 34, tacit approval after 30 days).
Foreign donor / donation restrictions: None notable (no foreign-funding register or prior-approval rule found); foreign NGOs operating locally need Ministry of Justice authorisation of their representation.
Annual compliance & reporting: No general NGO annual-filing regime published under Lei 25/VI/2003; statutory amendments/officer changes must be registered and published in the BO; utilidade pública bodies send annual report and accounts to the Chefia do Governo and must report statute changes (DL 59/2005), losing status if requirements lapse; entities with taxable income file IRPC returns with the DNRE.
Tax-exempt status & benefits: No automatic exemption for charities: Código do IRPC (Lei 82/VIII/2015) art. 13 exempts only religious bodies (cult income) and cultural, recreational, sporting and professional associations (subject to art. 5.2 conditions), excluding commercial/investment income; utilidade pública declaration (DL 59/2005/Lei 16/X/2022, by government despacho) brings tax exemptions and fee reductions; customs duty exemption on imports for mecenato-eligible non-profits (CBF art. 50); timing unpublished.
Bank account (remote feasibility): Needs a local visit: banks (Banco Comercial do Atlântico, Caixa Económica de Cabo Verde, Banco Interatlântico, BCN, BAI Cabo Verde) require the registered entity's certidão, NIF, BO publication and in-person KYC of signatories with passport; remote opening exists mainly for Cape Verdean emigrants via certified documents, not for foreign-founded NGOs.
